verdict.rationale: Resend is an email-sending API, not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The evidence shows only the opposite role: Resend publishes its own MCP server for Cursor, Claude and other MCP clients. That server-side capability does not transfer to the client-side story and is not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
